t: Din sapeq im qara qeriat shema
s: Din sapeq im qara qeriat shema ubo b' seipim: sapeq qara qeriat shema sapeq lo qara — tzarik lachazor veliqrot, mippene sheqqeriat shema hu min hattora, vesapeq shel tora hu lehachamir. Veap lehaomerim sheppasuq rishon o parasha rishona bilbad hi min hattora vehashshear taqqanat chakamim — tzarik lachazor veliqrot kol hag' parashiyyot, shekkak hayeta hattaqqana shekkol zeman sheyyiqra qeriat shema shel tora — yiqra kol hag' parashiyyot. Umittaam zeh tzarik gam ken lachazor ulebarek habberakot shellepaneha uleachareha im nistappeq lo im amaram, ap al pi shehabberakot middibre soperim, lepi shekkak hayeta hattaqqana shekkol zeman sheqqorin qeriat shema shel tora apillu mippene hassapeq bilbad — qorin otah bebirkoteha. Abal im yodea sheqqeraah ella shemmesuppaq im berak lepaneha uleachareha — lo yachazor vibarek, shessapeq berakot lehaqel. Veim mesuppaq gam beparashat tzitzit im qeraah biqriat shema im lav — tzarik lachazor veliqrotah im birkat "emet veyatztzib" shelleachareha, shehi gam ken besapeq im amarah, vehu sapeq shel tora. Vehu haddin le"emet veemuna" shel arbit, shemmitzvat aseh min hattora lizkor yetziat mitzrayim bekol yom, bayyom uballayla, shenneemar: "lemaan tizkor et yom tzetka meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyeka", "yeme chayyeka" — hayyamim, "kol yeme chayeka" — lehabi hallelot, vekevan shehu mechuyyab lehazkir yetziat mitzrayim mippene hassapeq — tzarik lehazkirah babberaka ubannussach shetiqqenu lah chakamim, shehi birkat "emet veyatztzib" (veyesh lo lachazor gam parashat tzitzit, shehi ve"emet veyatztzib" hen dabar echad umitzva achat). Veim amar ezeh pasuq shel yetziat mitzrayim o ezeh halaka shennizkar bah yetziat mitzrayim — yatza yede chobato min hattora, venaaset birkat emet veyatztzib sapeq dibre soperim, ulehaqel. Veyesh mi sheomer shemmikkol shekken im omer shirat hayyam sheyyatza min hattora:

Veim yadua lo sheqqara pasuq rishon, o apillu parasha rishona umesuppaq bashsheniyya — tzarik lachazor veliqrotah ledibre hakkol, ap lehaomerim shehi middibre soperim, lepi shemmittechilla kak tiqqenuha shettihyeh kiqriat shema shel tora, leinyan sheyyachazor liqrotah al hassapeq kemo qeriat shema shel tora:
